name: Hugging Face Storage Buckets
migrationEase: High (S3-compatible gateway at s3.hf.co works with AWS CLI, boto3, s5cmd; also hf CLI sync/cp and HfFileSystem/fsspec)
gotchas: Headline $/TB is the entry tier; price only drops at 50TB+/200TB+/500TB+ volume thresholds (see billing). Non-versioned and mutable by design — no object versioning, no object lock, no lifecycle rules. Egress is bundled rather than strictly free: included up to 8x your storage volume/month, overage terms not public. Advertised durability is not published for buckets specifically (Xet backend stores chunks in S3). S3 gateway is single-region (us-east-1) and ListObjectsV2 is unsupported; some SDKs that don't follow S3 302 redirects get proxied through the gateway (slower). Max single file is 500 GB (200 GB recommended).

pricing.egressFree: Included up to 8x stored volume/month; CDN egress bundled at no extra cost
pricing.billing: Per-TB monthly, pay-as-you-go above plan allowance. Volume tiers (public): $0.012/GB base -> $0.010 at 50TB -> $0.009 at 200TB -> $0.008 at 500TB. Private: $0.018 -> $0.016 -> $0.014 -> $0.012 at the same thresholds. Enterprise billed on deduplicated footprint. Listed storageStd is the entry tier.
pricing.freeTier: Free storage allowance on all accounts (100 GB private for free users); included storage scales with PRO/Team/Enterprise plans

features.apiDepth: Core S3 via s3.hf.co gateway (AWS CLI, boto3, s5cmd); no ListObjectsV2, no lifecycle, no bucket notifications. Native hf CLI + Python (huggingface_hub) + JS (@huggingface/hub) + HfFileSystem/fsspec

performance.throughput: CDN-backed; pre-warm cache into AWS/GCP regions near compute. No published throughput benchmark
performance.throttle: Hub API rate limits apply (per plan); not published as S3-style req/s

limits.maxBuckets: Not published (per namespace, standard Hub quota)

dataProtection.replRPO: N/A (single home region; CDN pre-warm is a cache, not replication)

advancedS3.deltaIceberg: Via HfFileSystem + Spark/PySpark; no native S3 Tables

ecosystem.cdn: Built-in HF CDN (AWS + GCP pre-warm at launch)
ecosystem.nativeCompute: HF Spaces, HF Jobs (volume-mount buckets read-write)
ecosystem.nativeAnalytics: HfFileSystem (pandas, DuckDB, Polars, Dask, Spark, 🤗 Datasets via fsspec)
